_about: Words that say a call walks the person through something on their phone or computer (D-906). Pip uses them only as a hint to ASK the owner whether the agent should guide callers on a screen; a false match costs one question. Founder-owned: add or remove words per language. Matching ignores the zero-width non-joiner, so a word matches with or without it. English words live in code (apps/api/copilot/agent_setup_actions.py).
